section: Allianz purchase: add-ons, Confirmation, switching insurer
setup:
• When: after Dev deploys EAINT-12406 to Secarang staging /ia/ and CIBO staging (not deployed yet on 28.10.2026, Azfar)
• Secarang staging /ia/ (https://staging.secarang.com/ia/car-insurance), desktop browser, no user login. First the site password page (password from the QA team, not written here; the same on /ia/ and /preprod/). The password page can come back on the Fiuu popup and on the Success page: enter the site password again there. The Fiuu Bank Simulator has its own username + password: never type the site password there (doc §2, §13). Stay on /ia/: a visitor form on /ia/ can open a /preprod/ page in a new tab (seen in the code, walk 28.10); do not continue on /preprod/
• CIBO staging https://staging.secarang.com/cibo (login page /cibo/auth/login; /ia/cibo is NOT CIBO), the QA team's admin login; it shares the back end with Secarang /ia/, so it records the /ia/ purchases (walk 28.10). Insurance Company filters (Transaction Management, Payment Report, Commission Report) are grouped by agency: Bintang Prospek (Chubb, RHB, Takaful Malaysia), Pemaju Eksklusif (Lonpac, TokioMarine, Zurich Takaful), Serba Sentral (Allianz, eTiqa); ticking a group header ticks all its insurers, so tick the insurer itself. There is no agency filter, and Payment Management has no insurer filter. Transaction Management shows no rows until [Search]; on other listings wait for the first load before [Search] (doc §10). Export narrow date ranges only
• Owner (Private tab): on the simulator any IC will do (Azfar 28.10); the QA team's /ia/ IC, postcode 55000, is a safe choice. /ia/ is on the simulator now, so made-up plates quote. With Allianz's real UAT API (a SIT pass Azfar may add) the vehicle and owner IC must be real: Allianz checks the IC for a quotation (Azfar 28.10). Phone on Confirmation: type it without the leading 0 (the field keeps +60). Never the QA's own name, IC, phone or address in evidence names
• Vehicle: an individual-owner renewal car that all three insurers quote (not used by another row). Tokio Marine showed 'Quotation unavailable' for a private car on /ia/ on 20.10 (team doc §4): a plate Tokio Marine quotes is needed (Q12)
• Payment: tile 'FPX Online banking' > RHB Bank > Fiuu Bank Simulator popup (its own username + password) > Status 'Approved' (00) > copy the TAC shown into 'Enter TAC' > [Pay now]. The popup closes itself after Pay (doc §5; proven on /ia/ 19.10, receipt Payment Method 'Online Banking - RHB Bank')
• Record the plate and the CIBO Transaction Ref. No. in Remarks (read again by RG_TS1)
